Subject: Invoice VAT details for Redwood subscription

Hi Markus,

We received invoice INV-2027-0118 for our Redwood Hosted API subscription. Our finance team needs the invoice to show the VAT treatment for accounting purposes — specifically we require either: (a) a net invoice with a clear ‘reverse charge — recipient to account for VAT’ line and our VAT ID included, or (b) a supplier self-billing agreement (if Redwood prefers).

Our VAT ID is SE123456789 (registered in Sweden). Can you confirm you can reissue the invoice with the reverse-charge wording and include your VAT validation reference? Also confirm whether any withholding applies. We need the updated invoice to release payment.

Quick details:
- Company: NorTech Ltd
- Billing contact: billing@northtech.com
- Billing address: NorTech Ltd, Storgatan 12, 111 22 Stockholm, Sweden

Please let me know what you need from our side to proceed — happy to send a PDF of the VAT registration certificate if that helps.

Thanks,
Anna

Hi Anna — thanks for flagging this. Looping in Vanessa (billing) and Ben (collections) to action.

Short answer: yes, we can reissue the invoice under reverse-charge for intra-EU B2B digital services provided you supply a copy of your VAT registration certificate and confirm the exact billing entity and address. We’ll also run a VAT-ID validation check (VIES) and include the validation reference on the invoice. No Swedish withholding is applicable on our side for SaaS (we treat this as a place-of-supply in the recipient country under the reverse-charge rule).

What I need from you to complete the reissue:
- VAT registration document (PDF) — attach in reply
- Confirmation that billing entity = NorTech Ltd (same as company name you provided) and that the address you supplied is the invoicing address
- If you prefer self-billing, indicate that now (we’ll direct our finance team to set up the self-billing agreement but that takes 5–7 business days)

Our process and timeline:
- Upon receipt of the VAT PDF + confirmation we’ll: 1) validate the VAT ID via VIES, 2) issue a credit note for INV-2027-0118, and 3) reissue INV-2027-0118-R with ‘reverse charge — recipient to account for VAT’ language and the VIES validation reference.
- Typical turnaround: within 48 hours of receiving the docs (earlier if Vanessa can process immediately).

I’ve attached a temporary invoice reissue template with placeholders so your AP team can see the wording we plan to use.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attached is our VAT registration (NorTech_VAT_certificate.pdf). Billing entity and address are correct as listed earlier. We do NOT want a self-billing agreement — please proceed with supplier reissue (credit note + reissued invoice).

A couple of clarifying notes from our AP:
- Please include the line: “Reverse charge — customer to account for VAT under Article 194 of the VAT Directive (place of supply: Sweden)”.
- Add our VAT ID exactly as: SE123456789 on the invoice header and the VIES validation reference in the footer.
- If you can include a short note that no withholding tax applies that would help our payment ledger.

We’ve attached the VAT PDF and our PO number: NT-PO-2027-334. We’re ready to release payment once we receive the corrected invoice.

Thanks again — Anna

Anna — all set. Thanks for the prompt reply and the VAT certificate. We validated SE123456789 via VIES (validation id: VIES-20270324-5582) and have processed the reissue.

What we did:
- Issued credit note CN-2027-0118 for the original invoice
- Issued reissued invoice INV-2027-0118-R (attached) with the exact wording you requested:
  "Reverse charge — customer to account for VAT under Article 194 of the VAT Directive (place of supply: Sweden)."
- Included VAT ID SE123456789 in the invoice header and VIES validation id in the footer
- Added line: "No withholding tax applied by supplier; recipient to account for any domestic obligations."

Attachments included with this message (PDFs):
- INV-2027-0118-redwood-reissue.pdf (final invoice)
- vat-validation-log.txt (VIES lookup snapshot)

Next steps:
- Please confirm receipt and we’ll mark the invoice ready for payment in our collections system. Ben will follow up on the payment schedule if you need a payment link or wiring instructions.

If anything looks off (formatting, legal name), flag it and we’ll rerun the reissue immediately.

Best,
